## Problem and reproduction

What problem does this change address? Include the smallest reproduction for a
defect, or the motivating example for a new outcome.

## Public outcome

What observable behavior changes? Include relevant CLI output, exit status,
artifact, or compatibility behavior.

## Validation

List the focused checks and complete repository checks you ran. For runtime
behavior changes, describe the baseline/candidate evidence and contract result
that demonstrate the outcome. Attach runpacks and an explained Proofline report
only when they are safe to share. Documentation-only changes do not need runtime
artifacts.

## Compatibility and privacy

- [ ] I considered the [runpack compatibility policy](../docs/compatibility.md)
      and [machine-readable output policy](../docs/machine-output.md), or this
      change does not affect either boundary.
- [ ] I reviewed commands, paths, runpacks, reports, output attachments, logs,
      and imported telemetry for sensitive data before sharing them.
- [ ] This pull request contains no suspected vulnerability or exploit detail;
      those are reported privately through [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
